reproduction.harness: All variants use one legacy/200 harness and MinimalGasReceiver. Candidate creation bytecode is loaded with vm.getCode and deployed using CREATE at identical addresses, preserving signed calldata. The isolated harness permits oversized reference builds for gas comparison; only size-compliant variants receive normal-limit Anvil deployment receipts.
reproduction.measurement: All 173 measurements use Forge --isolate. Write measurements include transaction intrinsic/calldata gas and refunds; Separate benchmarks sum 15 isolated single-unpack calls with snapshotValue. Read measurements are callee STATICCALL execution. Setup and harness gas are excluded. Deployment gas comes from actual Prague Anvil receipts, reverting to identical account state and nonces for each variant.
reproduction.environment: FOUNDRY_* and DAPP_* overrides are removed for isolated builds. Tracked sources and normal gas snapshots are never modified. The compiler baseline is rewritten only with --update-baseline.
